en: Team Aqua Grunt
Huh? You followed me all the way in here? Stay back! Don't come any closer!
text: Ha? M-ai urmărit până aici? Înapoi! Nu te apropia!

en: Peeko: Pihyoo...
The Wingull looks frightened.
Team Aqua Grunt
Grr... What a dead end! Whoever dug this tunnel gave up halfway. And now I'm stuck with you!
text: Grr... Ce fundătură! Cine a săpat tunelul ăsta a renunțat la jumătate. Și acum am rămas blocat cu tine!

en: Fine! If it's a battle you want, it's a battle you'll get!
text: Fie! Dacă vrei o luptă, o luptă o să ai!

en: Ugh, I lost? This job was supposed to be easy!
text: Uf, am pierdut? Treaba asta trebuia să fie ușoară!

en: Take your stupid parts, then! I was told to grab them, not to fight kids over them!
text: Ia-ți piesele alea prostești, atunci! Mi s-a zis să le iau, nu să mă bat cu copii pentru ele!

en: Team Aqua won't forget this. Out of my way!
text: Echipa Aqua n-o să uite asta. La o parte!

en: Mr. Briney
Peeko! Oh, my dear Peeko, you're safe! I was so worried about you!
text: Peeko! Vai, draga mea Peeko, ești teafără! Mi-a fost atât de frică pentru tine!

en: And you got her back for me? Thank you, thank you! I'm Briney. I live in the cottage on Route 104's beach.
text: Și tu mi-ai adus-o înapoi? Mulțumesc, mulțumesc! Sunt Briney. Stau în căsuța de pe plaja Rutei 104.

en: If ever there's anything I can do for you, come and see me. I'll never forget this!
text: Dacă pot face vreodată ceva pentru tine, vino la mine. N-o să uit asta niciodată!

en: Wanda! Can you hear me? I'll dig through to you, I promise! Nothing's going to keep us apart!
text: Wanda! Mă auzi? O să sap până la tine, promit! Nimic nu ne va despărți!

en: Oh, sorry. Wanda's my girlfriend. She's just on the other side of these rocks, but they're too hard to move.
text: A, scuze. Wanda e prietena mea. E chiar de cealaltă parte a stâncilor, dar sunt prea tari ca să le mut.

en: If only someone had a Pokémon strong enough to smash them...
text: Dacă ar avea cineva un Pokémon destul de puternic să le spargă...

en: One of the rocks is gone! Just one more and I'll be through to Wanda!
Is somebody there? My cousin Wally is coming to stay with us in Verdanturf. I hope this tunnel is open by then!
text: E cineva acolo? Vărul meu Wally vine să stea la noi în Verdanturf. Sper ca tunelul să fie deschis până atunci!

en: Young Man
You... you smashed the rocks! I've been chipping away at them for weeks, and you broke through in a moment!
I have to thank you. Please, take this! It lets a Pokémon shove even the heaviest boulders aside.
That's Strength. Once you've won the Badge for it, your Pokémon can push boulders around outside battle.
Wanda! I made it! Well... somebody made it for me.
Wanda
You silly thing! You didn't have to dig through a mountain. But thank you. Both of you!
Come on, let's go home. Wally will be arriving any day now!
The rock is riddled with cracks. Use Rock Smash?
The rock is riddled with cracks. Use Rock Smash?
